defects.canonical: The auto-derived fingerprint hashes only method, path, and body, omitting the authenticated account/tenant identifier. Two different tenants issuing identical requests produce the same idempotency key, so one tenant's operation is silently deduplicated against another's (cross-tenant collision / response leakage and dropped processing).
defects.why_subtle: The fingerprint looks complete and intentional; the missing tenant/account field is an absence, and method+path+body reads like a full request identity to a skimming reviewer.
